name: net_session_browser_dialog_connect_selected_provider
description: NetSessionBrowserDialog::ConnectSelectedProvider switches the selected DirectPlay provider, handles the first TCP/IP Winsock warning, and updates modem versus session-list UI state. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The smoke patches USER32 timer/combo/list messages, MFC CWnd button methods, zLoc, NetUi, DirectPlay provider selection, and RefreshSessionList so the branch behavior is isolated.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41b2f0 validates the thiscall ABI, KillTimer(hwnd, 2), provider selection through CB_GETCURSEL and CB_GETITEMDATA, null-provider button disabling, one-shot TCP/IP warning with zLoc message ids 18 and 38, CB_SETCURSEL fallback on warning decline, provider initialization, modem list reset and button text ids 53 and 54, non-modem RefreshSessionList and SetTimer(hwnd, 2, 1000, 0), button text ids 55 and 56, and m_selectedProviderIsModem updates.

The native smoke verifies the null provider, TCP/IP warning decline, TCP/IP warning accept, and modem provider paths, including timer calls, combo/list messages, warning text forwarding, provider-selection forwarding, refresh and timer behavior, button enable/text updates, and modem-state flag changes.
